question: Who among the following won the men’s singles title at the Indian Open 2025 Professional Squash Association (PSA) Copper event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kareem El Torkey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kareem El Torkey** emerged as the winner of the men’s singles title at the Indian Open 2025 Professional Squash Association (PSA) Copper event.
 
• The Indian Open is a prestigious squash tournament organized under the aegis of the Professional Squash Association (PSA).
 
• It is categorized as a **Copper-level event**, which is part of the PSA World Tour structure.
 
• El Torkey’s victory in 2025 further solidified his reputation as one of the prominent players in the international squash circuit.
 
• The event witnessed participation from top-ranked players, showcasing high-level competition and skill.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Professional Squash Association (PSA)**

 
 
• The PSA is the global governing body responsible for the administration of the men’s and women’s professional squash tours.
 
• It organizes tournaments across different levels, including Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Copper categories.
 
• The PSA World Tour provides a platform for elite squash players to compete and earn world ranking points.
 
 
 
• **Indian Open Squash Tournament**
 
 
• The Indian Open is a major squash tournament held annually in India, attracting top international players.
 
• It contributes to the growth of squash in India and promotes the sport among younger generations.
 
 
 
• **Squash Copper Events**
 
 
• Copper-level tournaments are part of the PSA Challenger Tour, designed to provide opportunities for upcoming players to gain experience and ranking points.
 
• They are crucial for players aiming to transition to higher-level PSA events.
 
 
 
• **Squash Scoring System**
 
 
• Matches are typically played in a best-of-five games format.
 
• Each game is played to 11 points, with a two-point advantage required to win a game.
